estimator.rows: 47 design elements (15 window with the gas state, 32 outer with the aerosol columns) + heritage triplet
estimator.covariance: Table 2 primary model: radiometric e^{y/2}/2000, per-line scatter sigma_eta = 0.02, discrepancy term at the measured scatter with Gaussian correlation l = 0.142 um
estimator.prior: round-70 gas, temperature, CFC, source-group and response priors; flat (1e6) on the seven aerosol parameters
estimator.generative: line scatter drawn per line through the line profiles; radiometric noise per element; discrepancy term drawn from its declared Gaussian covariance (implementation closure, not an independent discrepancy model)
